text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone can increase the risk of hyperkalemia when used concomitantly with lisinopril [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1]. Additionally, spironolactone labeling notes that serum potassium levels should be checked when ACE inhibitor therapy (such as lisinopril) is altered in patients receiving spironolactone [spironolactone:drug_interactions:1], and lisinopril labeling recommends monitoring the patient's serum potassium frequently if concomitant use is indicated [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1].
